A Journey of Responsibility. A New Chapter Ahead.

Over the past four years, my journey with NIRC of ICSI has been one of learning, responsibility and service.

From Member, NIRC in 2023 to Treasurer in 2024, Secretary in 2025, and Vice-Chairperson in 2026, every role has brought new responsibilities, new opportunities to contribute, and a deeper understanding of our profession.

As I look towards the next chapter, my focus remains on building a future-ready profession who use AI and technology, creating new professional opportunities, empowering women professionals, and strengthening connections across our member and student community.

I am pleased to announce my candidature for the Regional Council of NIRC of ICSI – 2026.

Building trust through service.
Creating impact through leadership.
Shaping the future of our profession with purpose and people.

Yours
CS Awanish Srivastava

#AwanishSrivastava #ICSI #NIRC #CompanySecretaries #FutureReady #ICSI2026 Ritu Goyal Nitin Goyal Krishna Kashyap
comment: AI adoption in the profession will depend not only on tools, but on ethical frameworks, member readiness and practical training that converts innovation into everyday value.
